title: F09.1 single-source command model is absent: ROMs, models and doc tables are hand transcriptions (REQ-VER-002)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-VER-002 (project charter, design) - audit verdict ABSENT

Single-source generation: ROMs, golden model, stimulus vectors and doc tables all derive from one command model

- In `hdl/` today: No command model exists: the only tracked data file is hdl/aecp/desc/example_milan_8.json (a descriptor image, not a command table). ROMs come from three unrelated hand-written generators: hdl/aecp/ucode/gen_ucode.py, hdl/acmp/rom/gen_ltn_rom.py (:12-16 'MIRRORS F05.3 ROW-BY-ROW', a hand transcription), hdl/aecp/desc/gen_desc_image.py. The uPC map is written twice and reconciled after the fact by scripts/check_upc_map.py:4-13 - the opposite of single-source. docs/architecture/09_verification.md:124-127 states the generated environment 'is still the target shape'.
- In `tb/` today: Reference models are hand-written per suite by design (09_verification.md:125-127; hdl/README.md rule 3); no stimulus-vector generator, no golden model, no generated doc table (F06.14, F05.3, F08.1 are hand-edited Markdown). Ver = lint and no gate exists (same search as REQ-REU-002).
- Missing: The machine-readable command/transition/T-constant model of F09.1 and the generators hanging off it; until then at least a drift gate between F06.14 and gen_ucode.py / KL_aecp_engine.sv OP_*_C, in the manner of check_upc_map.py.
- Searched with: tracked *.yaml|*.json|*.toml|*.csv (git ls-files); golden|command.model|machine-readable (scripts/, generators, tb/common, Makefile); gen_|generate (git ls-files) (confidence: high)

## Acceptance

1. One tracked machine-readable command table (opcode, sizes, status set, hazard class, lock/notify flags) exists
2. gen_ucode.py dispatch data and the F06.14 doc table are generated from it or gated against it by a script in scripts/
3. The gate runs in CI
4. REQ-VER-002 Cov/Arch cells and 09 section 8 record what is generated and what is still hand-written

Matrix finding link: GAP-11.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
